newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TIGER OATS SIGNS PETFOOD DEAL WITH HEINZ.
newsitem.headline: TIGER OATS SIGNS PETFOOD DEAL WITH HEINZ.

text.p: South African Tiger Oats Ltd said on Monday it had formed a joint venture to manufacture and market its brand name petfoods with Heinz SA, a unit of Heinz Co .
The venture, which will be 50.1 percent owned by Heinz and the rest by Tiger, will have annual sales of more than 170 million rand.
Heinz SA previously only operated in South Africa's food service business, but will now expand into petfoods with Tiger Oats' brands Husky, Pamper, Dogmor and Catmor.

"Heinz has identified petfood as one of its core categories and will be able to provide the joint-venture with world class technology, expertise and products," said Tiger Oats managing director Nick Dennis.
South Africa's petfood market grows more than 14 percent a year. No financial terms of the deal were disclosed.
